task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue imperial edict declaring epidemic emergency across major cities, set mortality-driven response priority, and personally oversee daily progress reports
Coordinate the cross-ministry response, convene daily council briefings, align policy between finance, works, and military branches, and track case/death tallies per city
Deploy garrison troops to enforce city cordons and household quarantine, secure medicine and grain convoys, and prevent panic-driven flight from infected cities
Open the emergency treasury and release granary reserves, procure medicinal herbs and food for quarantined wards, and underwrite compensation for households under lockdown
Rapidly construct isolation wards and plague hospitals in each affected city, and ramp up imperial workshops to produce herbal remedies, cloth masks, and disinfectants at scale
